extracted_decision.summary: Manager ordered the simplest possible UX: one button opens one modal with a validated form for the full minimal data set; target state is chosen from existing states only; on submit the gift enters the normal engine cycle.
extracted_decision.rationale: Reduce UI complexity while still collecting all required data and ensuring adopted gifts follow existing state and engine pathways.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: One-button/modal simplicity reduces UI surface but requires the form to carry the full minimal data set.
